dimensions.name: GAME_DATE
dimensions.comment: Calendar date the game was played.

dimensions.name: COLLEGE
dimensions.comment: College attended. Null for many players.

dimensions.name: IS_ROOKIE
dimensions.comment: True in a player's first season.

dimensions.name: PLAYER_NAME
dimensions.comment: Player full name. High cardinality -- a Cortex Search service would improve fuzzy name matching.

dimensions.name: POSITION
dimensions.comment: Clean position label derived from the position abbreviation. Unknown for players with no position on file.

dimensions.name: POSITION_GROUP
dimensions.comment: Coarse unit grouping. Defensive groups are the ones that appear in this view.

dimensions.name: TEAM_ABBREVIATION
dimensions.comment: Three-letter code of the team the player appeared for in this game.

dimensions.name: TEAM_FULL_NAME
dimensions.comment: Full name of the team the player appeared for in this game.

dimensions.name: SEASON
dimensions.comment: NFL season. Currently covers 2023 to 2025; new seasons are added as they load. A season starting in year N runs through February of N+1.

dimensions.name: SEASON_TYPE
dimensions.comment: Preseason, Regular Season or Postseason. Almost all questions mean Regular Season.

dimensions.name: WEEK
dimensions.comment: Week within the season phase. Regular season is weeks 1 to 18; numbering restarts for preseason and postseason.

metrics.name: DEFENSIVE_SCORES
metrics.comment: Touchdowns scored on interception or fumble returns.

metrics.name: GAMES_PLAYED
metrics.comment: Games in which the player recorded defensive production.

metrics.name: PRESSURES
metrics.comment: Sacks plus quarterback hits. The closest available proxy for pressure -- this source has no true pressure or hurry count.

metrics.name: TAKEAWAYS_TOTAL
metrics.comment: Interceptions plus fumble recoveries. The standard combined ball-production measure.

metrics.name: TOTAL_INTERCEPTIONS
metrics.comment: Total interceptions caught. This is a defensive takeaway, not interceptions thrown by a quarterback.

metrics.name: TOTAL_PASSES_DEFENDED
metrics.comment: Total passes broken up or deflected.

metrics.name: TOTAL_QB_HITS
metrics.comment: Total quarterback hits that were not sacks.

metrics.name: TOTAL_SACKS
metrics.comment: Total sacks recorded BY this defender. Can be fractional -- a shared sack is 0.5. Do not confuse with sacks allowed by an offense.

metrics.name: TOTAL_TACKLES_FOR_LOSS
metrics.comment: Total tackles behind the line of scrimmage.

facts.name: ASSISTED
facts.comment: Assisted tackles, derived as total minus solo.

facts.name: FUM_TDS
facts.comment: Touchdowns scored on a fumble recovery.

facts.name: HITS
facts.comment: Quarterback hits that were not sacks.

facts.name: INT_TDS
facts.comment: Touchdowns scored on an interception return.

facts.name: SACKS
facts.comment: Sacks recorded. FLOAT: a shared sack is 0.5.

facts.name: TFL
facts.comment: Tackles made behind the line of scrimmage.
